final: SELECT AVG(s.instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(s.instownpct / mix.avg_ownership) AS avg_ratio_to_mix, AVG(s.instownpct - overall.avg_ownership) AS avg_excess FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN (SELECT t2.ordertypedist, AVG(s2.instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s2 JOIN transactionrecord AS t2 ON s2.transref = t2.transreg WHERE t2.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s2.instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t2.ordertypedist) AS mix ON mix.ordertypedist = t.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL) AS overall WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct > overall.avg_ownership
